question: What is the nature and benefit of the consecration described in this manner?
premises: The consecration has been described in the preceding manner.
It is declared in the text.
It grants what is desired in relation to Śiva, the foe of Tripura.
inference: The consecration thus declared grants what is desired by the foe of Tripura.
plain_english: Thus the consecration has been declared, and it grants what is desired by the enemy of Tripura.
